headlines.title: Trump says he will meet with Kim Jong Un this year
headlines.description: President Trump told reporters that he expects to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un this year. NBC News' Courtney Kube reports on the comments shortly after the president announced military exercises with South Korea would be scaled back.

headlines.title: How Sen. Darline Graham’s debate blunder could give undecided voters ‘some pause’
headlines.description: Shelby Talcott, Steve Ricchetti and Ashley Davis join the Meet the Press NOW panel to discuss Sen. Darline Graham’s (R-S.C.) debate performance and key gaps in national security expertise compared to her late brother Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.).

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: What’s Behind Harry’s Decision to Move Family Back to UK?
headlines.description: NBC News royal commentator Daisy McAndrew joins TODAY to weigh in on what may have prompted the surprise decision by Prince Harry and Meghan Markle to move back to the United Kingdom, what it will mean for his fraught relationship with the British tabloids, and how King Charles’ health issues may have played a role in the move. “It certainly shows that Harry is serious about wanting to spend more time with his family,” she says.

headlines.title: ICE electric gloves already being used in schools
headlines.description: Parents in one community were surprised to learn the shock gloves soon to be used by ICE officers have been used in schools. Police say they won't use them after backlash and a request from the district superintendent. NBC News' Julia Ainsley reports.

headlines.title: More than 80 million Americans under heat alerts
headlines.description: That unrelenting summer heat is now bringing new storms to millions. With students going back to class, what are schools doing to keep them safe? NBC News’ Priscilla Thompson reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: This Rubbermaid container keeps food fresh, supplies organized and your pantry looking neat — it’s $12 today
headlines.description: Rubbermaid’s popular food storage container with a snap-to-close lid, is one sale for more than 25% off on Amazon. It’s perfect for dry foods like grains and more.

headlines.title: Bogg Bag vs. Owala, Away, Yeti and Simple Modern: Which brand has the most durable beach bag?
headlines.description: We tested multiple popular beach bags, including the Bogg Bag, and compared it with competitors from Owala, Simple Modern and more.

headlines.title: The best styling products to keep flyaway hairs at bay
headlines.description: Our editors spent three months testing hair styling products to keep flyaways, baby hairs and frizz at bay. Shop the best options from Dae, Briogeo, Fenty Beauty and more.

headlines.title: Tick prevention for dogs: Vets explain how to beat the blood-suckers
headlines.description: Dogs are more vulnerable to Lyme disease than ever. These are the best vet-approved tick preventatives for dogs and how to check your dog for ticks.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy Trial: Defense Focuses on Postpartum Psychosis
headlines.description: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, a Massachusetts mom who admits to killing her three young children before attempting to take her own life, is entering a crucial chapter with key testimony for the defense coming from a psychologist. Her legal team is arguing she suffered from postpartum psychosis, sparking renewed conversations around postpartum mental health. NBC’s Laura Jarrett reports for TODAY.
